messages:
Sam W: FYI — hit a blocker on the Nimbus Health SI delivery. Their k8s nodes are failing startup for our marketplace image. init-container exits with TLS trust errors. Need quick arch review and escalation to field eng. (root cause looks like transparent corporate proxy rewriting cert chain)
Lina K: can you paste the init logs?
Sam W: ```
E0220 09:12:03  init.go:47] rpc error: code = Unknown desc = x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
W0220 09:12:04  kubelet.go:102] failed to pull image registry.redwood.marketplace/nimbus:v1.2.0: Get "https://...": x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
```
Raj P: looks like their proxy is doing MITM TLS. Two quick options: (1) add the proxy CA to node truststore (daemonset), or (2) route image pulls through a private registry we push to inside their network.
Devon S: +1 to Raj. If customer policy forbids node CA changes, option 2 is the safest. We can also provide signed image bundle and offline load steps for air-gapped installs.
Sam W: customer says they won't change node truststore without security signoff. Can we fast-track a private registry push? What's the engineering effort?
Maria G: @Sam W @Devon S scheduling 1h arch sync tomorrow 10am PT w/ field eng, security, and partner SI. Agenda: network path (proxy), auth for registry, private registry vs agent-based pull, and rollout plan. Please bring logs, kubelet config, proxy fingerprint. :calendar:
Sam W: added — I'll drop the kubelet config + registry logs into the meeting thread. Also they mentioned image verification via cosign; need to confirm chain verification behavior when proxy rewrites certs.
Lina K: quick checklist for the call: 1) init logs, 2) proxy CA cert, 3) kubelet config & imagePullSecrets, 4) firewall rules, 5) SI partner contact info. I'll DM the template. :white_check_mark:
Devon S: I'll prep the private registry push runbook and a minimal daemonset that injects CA and reconfigures container runtime; labelled 'opt-in' for security review.
Sam W: thanks. tagging @here in case anyone from infra wants to join :eyes:
Devon S: filing escalation ticket with ops: ESC-2026-1198 — will link after creation.
Maria G: thanks everyone — ping me if the customer refuses both options, we'll escalate to partnerships legal + security for ad-hoc exception.
